# Players Studio
Barbershop in downtown Oakville, Ontario, Canada.
Address: 295 Lakeshore Rd E, Oakville, ON L6J 1J3
Phone: 905-844-4443
Services: haircuts, fades, beard trims and lineups, kids haircuts ($24-$50 CAD). First haircut for new clients: $35.
Hours: Mon-Thu 9am-9pm, Fri 9am-8pm, Sat-Sun 9am-7pm. Walk-ins welcome.
Rating: 5.0 from 600+ reviews on Booksy and Google.
